home.feature_description:
At Threeclipse Studios, we blend creativity with technology to deliver unforgettable gaming experiences. Our dedicated team is passionate, pushing the boundaries of interactive storytelling.

As an indie studio based in Montreal, Canada, we're a nexus of developers and creative minds who strive to sharpen minds and ethics alike.

about.feature_description: At Threeclipse Studios, we blend creativity with technology to deliver unforgettable gaming experiences. Our dedicated team is passionate, pushing the boundaries of interactive storytelling.
about.section_1_content:
I believe in creating games that are not only fun but also meaningful. Quality, integrity, and continuous growth are at the core of everything I do. I value collaboration, clean code, and building experiences that leave a lasting impression on players.

I am committed to pushing my limits, embracing challenges, and always striving to improve both as a developer and as a creator. I believe in giving back to the community, sharing knowledge, and helping others grow in their own game development journeys.
about.section_2_content:
With a strong foundation in game development and programming, my expertise spans across multiple disciplines. I have professional experience with Unity and Godot engines, as well as deep knowledge in custom engine development with Vulkan.

My technical skills include C#, C++, Java, JavaScript, and Python. I specialize in multiplayer networking, AI programming, cross-platform development, and performance optimization. I have successfully published games on Steam, Google Play, and itch.io, and I continue to explore new technologies to expand my capabilities.

I am passionate about creating immersive gameplay, designing intuitive user interfaces, and writing clean, maintainable code that powers unforgettable gaming experiences.

privacyNotice.title: Privacy Notice
privacyNotice.introduction:
As a game studio based in Montreal, Canada, Threeclipse Inc. complies with Canadian privacy laws and data protection regulations. Specifically, Quebec's Law 25, CASL, and PIPEDA.

1. User-Submitted Input

We collect data that you voluntarily provide through our contact forms, email, or newsletter subscription. This may include:

Your personal information

  • Names
  • Email
  • Subscription preferences
  • Application Materials (e.g., resumes, portfolios)

How we use this data:

  • Responding to inquiries
  • Reviewing job and incubator program applicants
  • Sending newsletters and updates about Threeclipse Inc. (with your express consent)
  • Measuring engagement to improve communications

We process your data based on:

  • Your consent for newsletters
  • Contractual necessity for job and program applications
  • Legitimate interest for responding to inquiries

2. Metadata Collected by Vendors

2.a. Hosting Service (Netlify)

This website is hosted by Netlify. As part of standard internet operations, Netlify may automatically collect technical information such as:

  • Your IP address
  • Browser type
  • Device details

This data is used for performance, analytics, and security purposes.

NOTE: We do not use cookies, third-party trackers, or analytics tools ourselves to track website analytics.

2.b. Email & Newsletter Service (MailerLite)

Threeclipse Inc. uses MailerLite to manage newsletter subscriptions. When you subscribe, we collect:

  • Your name
  • Email address
  • Subscription preferences

This is done through explicit opt-in to receive your consent and personalize the service.

After enrollment, MailerLite may automatically collects:

  • Your IP address
  • Email opens, clicks, and engagement metrics

Data for the newsletter service is stored on MailerLite's EU-based servers with encryption and access controls. MailerLite is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and GDPR-compliant.

Your Rights:

You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in any newsletter email. When you unsubscribe, MailerLite automatically removes your information and engagement data.

You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data by contacting support@threeclipse.com.

We comply with Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL) and Quebec's Law 25 by requiring express consent before sending marketing communications. For more information regarding MailerLite's security practices, visit https://www.mailerlite.com/trust-page (external Trust Page)

3. Children's Data

We do not knowingly collect or store data from individuals under the age of 16. If you believe a minor has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately.

4. Cross-Border Data Transfers

Your personal information may be stored or processed outside of Québec, including in the United States or European Union, through services such as Netlify, Gmail/Google Workspace, Zoho, and MailerLite.

We have completed multiple Privacy Impact Assessments (PIA) and selected providers that maintain strong security and confidentiality safeguards.

5. Retention and Deletion

We retain personal data for the following periods:

  • Contact form submissions: 1 year
  • Resumes and job applications: 3 years

Newsletter subscriptions: Until you unsubscribe or request deletion (up to 30 days for verified deletion requests)

After these periods, your data is securely deleted.

6. Consent and Your Rights Under Law 25

By submitting your information through our contact forms, email, or newsletter subscription, you consent to the collection, use, and storage of your personal data as described in this notice.

You have the right to:

  • Access your personal information (within 30 days of a verified request)
  • Correct inaccurate or outdated data
  • Withdraw your consent at any time
  • Request deletion where appropriate (processed within 30 days)
  • File a complaint regarding our privacy practices

To exercise these rights, email us at support@threeclipse.com.

7. Incident Response Procedures

In the event of a data breach affecting your personal information, we will notify you and the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec within 72 hours as required by Law 25.

8. Privacy Officer

Name: Gabrielle Nestor
Title: Privacy Officer, Threeclipse Inc.
Contact: Gabrielle.Nestor@threeclipse.com
Responsible for: Law 25 compliance, user privacy requests, and incident response.
